newsitem.title: GREECE: TOP BRASS TO ATTEND ECONOMIST'S GREEK CONFERENCE.
newsitem.headline: TOP BRASS TO ATTEND ECONOMIST'S GREEK CONFERENCE.

text.p: Prominent Greek and European Union political leaders and bankers will meet in Athens at a conference on Greece's economic development organised by the Economist, organisers said.

Speakers include Greek Prime Minister Costas Simitis, former German foreign minister Hans-Dietrich Genscher, Greek Finance Minister Yannos Papandoniou, Greek central bank Governor Lucas Papadimos and Greek Industry Minister Vasso Papandreou.

European Commissioner Christos Papoutsis and former European Commissioner Carlos Ferrer will also attend next week's "Round table conference with the Greek government" organised by the Economist Conferences.

The group will discuss Greece's competitiveness in a global market, tackling issues such as investment motives, the role of the domestic banking system and Greece's foreign policy, with emphasis on economic and commercial relations with the Balkans and Asia.
"The main themes will be the Greek economy's convergence programme, commercial and industrial policies, large infrastructure projects and privatisation," the organisers said in a statement.
The conference will be held between April 7 and 9, 1997. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
